name: aetherize_returns_a_stolen_attacker_to_its_owner
notes: Printed: 'Return all attacking creatures to their owner's hand.' Seat 1 owns Borrowed Beast, but seat 0 gained control of it on turn 1 and by turn 3 it has been under seat 0's control since the turn began, so it may attack. Seat 0 attacks with it; seat 1 casts Aetherize after attackers are declared. The Beast goes to its OWNER's hand (seat 1), not the controller's: seat 1 holds the card it drew on turn 2 plus the Beast, seat 0 only the card it drew on turn 3. Nothing is blocked and no combat damage is dealt.
